inventory.scope: Models returned by this key. Listing does not prove generation quota or successful audio/text generation.

methodology.transport: Google Gemini API OpenAI-compatible chat completions
methodology.ordering: Alternating models per goal; starter alternates for each next goal.
methodology.latency: Successful requests: wall-clock start through complete JSON body, excluding inventory/local validation. Timeout durations are abort elapsed times censored at 25 seconds, not completed generation latency.
methodology.promptTemplate:
This is a synthetic model comparison, not a real user request.
Create three concrete, simple steps towards this sample goal: {SYNTHETIC_GOAL}.
Tiny: at most 2 minutes and doable at home. Small: at most 10 minutes. Full: at most 30 minutes.
Each step is one observable action, starts with a verb, and is at most 60 characters.
Specify a short duration or a bounded quantity so the size can be assessed.
Use plain language. Do not give medical advice. Do not include feelings, exclamation marks, or "try to".
Return only a JSON object with this exact shape: {"steps":{"tiny":"...","small":"...","full":"..."}}.
Do not repeat the shape example. No markdown, explanation, or other fields.

decision.reason: Do not switch on this evidence: the smaller Gemma timed out on all three attempts, and no result from either model arrived under five seconds. Keep the configured 31B unchanged. Five requested sample ladders could not be shown because their one allowed attempt timed out; none were invented or retried.
decision.limits: Three attempts per model at one point in time are not a stable performance benchmark or a guarantee. A timeout does not establish that the model can never generate a suitable ladder.
